author: ETA PRIME
description:
n this video, I’m testing Minisforum’s brand new Thunderbolt 5 eGPU dock, the successor to the DG1. The DEG2 supports Thunderbolt 5, OCuLink, and USB4 v2, plus it adds an M.2 slot for storage, 2.5GbE Ethernet, extra USB ports, and up to 140W charging from the Thunderbolt 5 port. I build it DIY-style with an RTX 5070 (12GB) and an ATX PSU, then compare connection speeds using USB4 v2 vs USB4 v1 

Buy It Here: Buy the DEG2 here: https://tidd.ly/4rn5eGa

On the Minisforum M02 Ultra (USB4 v2 ports), 3DMark Time Spy jumps from the built-in setup to 17K+ with the RTX eGPU, then I test games like Borderlands 4, Spider-Man 2, and Forza Horizon 5. I also hook it to a handheld (USB4) to see the real-world gains. Final verdict: TB5/USB4 v2 helps—especially for tougher eGPU titles—but if you’re only on TB4, it may not be worth upgrading yet unless you need the extra I/O, M.2, and Ethernet.
